title: 1951 AHSME Problem 8
statement: The price of an article is cut \(10\%.\) To restore it to its former value, the new price must be increased by:

solutions.text:
Let the original price be \(1.\) The reduced price is \(0.9.\) The required fractional increase is \[ \frac{1-0.9}{0.9}=\frac19, \] which is \(11\dfrac19\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: After the cut, the price is \(90\%\) of the original
If the required increase is \(p\), solve \(0.9(1+p)=1\)
